Package dev.opencollab.paletter

Class PaletteLayer.Builder

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.PaletteLayer.Builder
Enclosing class:
PaletteLayer
public static final class PaletteLayer.Builder extends Object
Collects the content of a PaletteLayer. Not thread safe; every method throws NullPointerException for a null argument unless the parameter is marked @Nullable, and returns this builder.
Since:
1.0.0

  • Method Details

    • minEngineVersion

      public @NonNull PaletteLayer.Builder minEngineVersion(@NonNull String minEngineVersion)
      Sets the min_engine_version of the pack this layer stands for. BDS writes a molangVersion into every block of a pack that follows it (captured from 1.26.36.1 on: 1.16.100 gives 0, 1.19.40 gives 6, the packs of the current formats 13); the blocks of this layer get the one of this version. Unset, the layer is of the newest engine.
      Parameters:
      minEngineVersion - the pack's engine version, dotted numbers such as 1.19.40
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the version is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if it is not dotted numbers
      Since:
      1.0.0

    • overrideItem

      @Experimental public @NonNull PaletteLayer.Builder overrideItem(@NonNull String identifier, @NonNull Consumer<ItemOverride> modifier)
      Changes an existing item definition. Skipped (and reported) for versions without the item.

      Experimental. BDS replaced the components of an overridden vanilla data driven item; for hard coded items it accepted the feather at format 1.10 (as a legacy item) and rejected the stick at 1.26.60, and it rejected a legacy bread at 1.16.100 (1.20 and up was never tried). Paletter refuses nothing. The client's behaviour for Paletter's overrides is unverified on a client (no client test exists). The API may change.

      Parameters:
      identifier - the identifier of the vanilla item
      modifier - called with the override to configure while a palette is compiled, once per version; it must not depend on external mutable state
      Returns:
      this builder
      Since:
      1.0.0

    • voxelShape

      public @NonNull PaletteLayer.Builder voxelShape(@NonNull String identifier, @NonNull VoxelShape shape)
      Defines a voxel shape, as a file in the shapes directory of a behavior pack does: the shape Bedrock culls the faces of neighbouring blocks with, for the custom blocks that name it as the culling_shape of their minecraft:geometry. A voxel shape is a culling shape, not a collision or selection shape (those are BlockShapes), and the Script API does not expose it. The palette sends it with Palette.voxelShapesPacket().

      Shapes get their ids in the order they are registered (BDS: in the order of their file names), which a client does not see. BDS refuses the minecraft namespace, which fails here with its reason; the checks of the shape itself are those of VoxelShape.ofBoxes(String, float...).

      Parameters:
      identifier - the name blocks use, e.g. my:half_pipe
      shape - the shape
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the identifier or the shape is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the identifier is refused (see above) or already defined in this layer
      Since:
      1.0.0
